p: 68 Fanshen Road, Xin'an Subdistrict, Bao'an District 宝安区新安街道翻身路68号

Delicious Hakka food. The specialty is Chetian-style tofu (Chetian being a town out in Heyuan, Hakka country to the northeast of Shenzhen). Good vegetarian options, though if you're vegetarian you should order carefully as Hakka-style…
